content.comment_body: Hello, For my first [product_name] project, I'm trying to set up SMS notifications using the [product_name] [product_name] ([article_no]) module. Since I'm new to variable memory mapping for [product_name], my initial goal was to make the Power on/off notification work as a basic test—if SMS is sent by the [product_name] module before connecting it to the base module, that would confirm everything is functional. However, it's not working reliably. • I have a cellular module installed: SIM7600G-H LTE CAT-4 mPCIe • I tried three different SIM cards from major mobile service providers • None of the SIM cards are prepaid and all support SMS • Cellular Data > Test connection passes for all SIM cards • Phone number is entered with international exit code (+359...), and I also tried without it • One SIM card required a PIN code. After configuring the PIN, that card sent one Power on SMS and one Power off SMS, but nothing after repeatedly plugging/unplugging the module • SMS Center number is auto-detected correctly for each SIM—varies by provider • APN and Dial number fields are not configured • No firmware updates available for [article_no], so none have been applied • Multiple factory resets did not resolve the issue • A fourth SIM card sent one Power on SMS, then stopped sending further SMS • Since there are no additional configuration options, my next option is to swap the cellular module for a Telit LE910C1-EU LTE CAT-1 mPCIe. If that doesn’t help, I may try [product_name] with integrated cellular engine instead. Has anyone encountered similar issues or have suggestions for a solution? Any advice would be appreciated! Thank you!

analysis.insight_summary: The user is dealing with unreliable SMS notification functionality from a [product_name] Communication Module when attempting to send power cycle alerts. Although the module recognizes various SIM cards and passes cellular connectivity tests, SMS notifications are only sent once per card or intermittently and do not trigger reliably on subsequent power cycles. Attempts to resolve the issue by switching SIM cards, modifying settings, performing factory resets, and searching for firmware updates have not helped. The limited available configuration options and absence of updates have led to user frustration and doubts about the module’s reliability.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the [product_name] module to consistently send SMS notifications on every power on or off event, without needing complicated configuration or replacing SIM cards.
